payload.comment: Too detailed. Limitation should not be the emphasis of the paper. We should be honest about the limitation, but don't try to explain everything. The limitation section for workshop is more like prospective, i.e. what we can do to further improve, but we haven't yet. Don't use this section to criticize yourself.
